basic_info.description:
This immaculate and stunning condominium features two bedrooms and two bathrooms, boasting a modern and contemporary look and feel. One of the standout features of this property is the breathtaking view of Alcatraz, creating a captivating backdrop for daily living. The condominium offers an easeful flow between the beautiful kitchen, eating and living areas, making it ideal for both comfortable living and entertaining guests. Large windows and an open layout create a bright and airy atmosphere throughout the condominium, filling the rooms with natural light.

 In addition, there is an in-unit washer and dryer plus a deeded garage parking space. This condominium is truly move-in ready, with modern fixtures and finishes, ensuring a hassle-free transition into your new home. Situated on the edge of the picturesque Russian Hill neighborhood, this condominium offers a prime location in the heart of San Francisco just steps away from Washington Square Park.

*Condo is not furnished*

Owner pays water, trash. Will consider a cat, small dog but would prefer to discuss and/or meet them first.

One private parking spot in the garage under the unit, with some small space for storage at the front.

Noise complaints from up/downstairs neighbors need to be respected (they are really great, but you'll need to be respectful). 

Smoking in the condo, or directly out front of the condo, is not tolerated. Smoke alarms are sensitive and *will* go off.

Applications must have a credit score of 700+ and be able to prove income equal to or in excess of 3x the monthly rent.

Private showings can be scheduled upon request.
